question: Why did Hezekiah choose for the shadow to go back ten steps as his sign?
options: Going back meant he would live longer
It is easy for a shadow to go forward, so going back would be a true sign
Isaiah told him to choose that
Going forward would bring bad luck
explanation: Hezekiah said it was a simple matter for the shadow to go forward ten steps, so he asked for it to go back ten steps.
